**Detailing polygon clipping and car-ground physics**

I’m outlining SAT-based clipping for polygons and how to choose reference and incident faces by overlap axis and normals. There’s also a description of modeling car-ground interaction including friction, rolling vs sliding drag, acceleration before impact, and solver handling of contacts and friction with specific physical parameters.

item.text: The simulation will use a fixed timestep and separate rigid bodies for every brick. Depth layers will share the car’s momentum while using separate contact planes, so increasing wall thickness adds resistance without overlapping bricks pushing each other apart.
